title: My New Neighbor Waves At The Exact Same Second Every Morning
description:
A short fiction story. When you move somewhere new, you notice things. This is about the thing I noticed at 7:14 every morning.

#shorts #shortstory #fiction

scenes.text: When I moved in, I noticed my neighbor across the street waves at me every morning. Same time. Seven fourteen, exactly.
Not close to seven fourteen. Exactly. I started timing it on my phone out of curiosity, and it never once changed.
So I tested it. I left ten minutes late one day. I still caught the wave, dead on seven fourteen, like they knew I'd be there.
I asked a different neighbor about them. She looked confused. She said that house has been empty for eight months.
I stood on my porch the next morning, staring at that dark, empty window, waiting.
At seven fourteen, I saw the wave again. It was in the glass. I was looking at my own reflection the whole time.
